class.name: SuspensionData
class.brief_description: Configuration data for vehicle suspension parameters.
class.description: SuspensionData is a [Resource] that holds the tunable parameters for a vehicle's suspension system. It defines the suspension length, rest compression ratio, and damping ratio used by [Axle] and [Wheel] nodes to compute per-wheel suspension forces.

method.name: set_suspension_length
method.description: Sets the maximum suspension travel length in meters.

method.name: get_suspension_length
method.description: Returns the maximum suspension travel length in meters.

method.name: set_rest_compression
method.description: Sets the fraction of suspension travel compressed at rest under the vehicle's weight. A value of 0.25 means 25% compression at rest.

method.name: get_rest_compression
method.description: Returns the fraction of suspension travel compressed at rest.

method.name: set_damping_ratio
method.description: Sets the suspension damping ratio. Values below 1.0 are underdamped, 1.0 is critically damped, and above 1.0 is overdamped.

members.member: Maximum suspension travel length in meters.
Fraction of suspension travel compressed at rest under the vehicle's weight.
Damping ratio for the suspension. 1.0 is critically damped.
